_note: Boxes are NORMALISED to the tile (0-1). A big pale boulder mass fills the middle; living material is confined to the left edge and a band along the bottom. The bottom band uses a DIFFERENT leaf grammar -- brick-like horizontal dashes -- and should not share a card style with the round-leaf trees.

objects.name: broadleaf crown reaching in from the top left
objects.note: the same great broadleaf as t009's; clipped -- expect a seam merge to the left

objects.name: bare ochre branch curling below that crown
objects.note: a leafless limb. It is the HINGE LINE for the crown above it, not a card of its own

objects.name: teal and pink round-leaf tree down the left edge
objects.note: clipped; pink accents among teal leaves

objects.name: dense band of brick-mark foliage along the bottom
objects.note: leaves drawn as short horizontal dashes packed in rows -- a different grammar from the round-leaf trees. Hinge as a shallow mass with small swing; a big angle will read as the ground tilting

objects.name: dark needle pine at the bottom right
objects.note: the darkest foliage in the tile; fine needle fans

objects.name: bare young sapling above the thicket
objects.note: NO LEAVES. Nothing to cut cards from -- if it must move it is a whole-twig sway, not a foliage hinge

objects.name: the great pale boulder mass filling the centre
objects.note: the largest bare rock passage in z3w -- NEVER animate, and the single best clean-plate donor in the zone

objects.name: dark combed ridge across the top right
objects.note: raking 牛毛皴 strokes read as texture at distance, never as leaves

objects.name: dark wedge of rock at the lower left
objects.note: the darkest rock in the tile; tonally identical to leaf ink, which is why tone alone cannot separate them
